summary: Formats a percent value as a string. It initializes a local 61-byte buffer from global byte_5EA438 (first byte plus zero fill), fetches a float pointer via a virtual call through vtable entry at offset 0xB4, and when the result is non-null converts the float to an integer percentage with CRTFtol(value*100.0+0.5), formats it as "%d%%" via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, and stores the result with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Returns 0. Invoked by ParameterValueClampingAcrossArray and SuspensionFloatClamp.

Load the vtable pointer from *this and invoke the virtual method at vtable offset 0xB4 to obtain a float pointer used as the percent value source.
Guard on the float pointer returned by the vtable+0xB4 call: if non-null, format the percentage; if null, skip formatting and jump to the string-store step.
Convert the dereferenced float to an integer percent value: CRTFtol(*p * 100.0 + 0.5), rounding half away from zero before truncation.
Format the integer percent value into the buffer using the "%d%%" format string (global aD) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Store the formatted buffer into the persistent string buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
